law_record.title: Restricted use of bus and taxicab stands
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than a bus in a bus stop, or a taxicab in a taxicab stand, when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed, except that the driver of a passenger vehicle may temporarily stop there and for the purpose of and while actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading of passengers when such stopping does not interfere with any bus or taxicab waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

activation_conditions: the place is an officially designated and signed bus stop or taxicab stand
the subject is not of the entitled class
the subject stops, stands or parks there
exceptions: a passenger vehicle may stop temporarily while actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading passengers, provided it does not interfere with a bus or taxicab waiting or about to enter the zone
residue: 'expeditiously' is a judgement element; the observable evidence is the door state and the passenger exchange
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: 'temporarily' and 'expeditiously' bound the excepted stop; both need a declared duration
the interference test runs while a bus or taxicab waits
